messages:
Alex C: Quick heads-up — ran a small bake where we enable AWQ INT8 + kv-prefix cache alongside continuous batching and saw a p99 token latency spike and a small accuracy delta. Putting notes here so we don't lose context.

Maria P: Can you paste the repro steps and the config you used?

Alex C: Repro steps: start model v2-awq-int8 on canary pool, enable kv-prefix cache with default settings, run steady QPS 1200 rps synthetic mix (50/50 short/long). Config snippet: 

```
model: gpt-7b-awq-int8
batching:
  continuous: true
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_items: 64
  batch_timeout_ms: 8
kv_cache:
  enabled: true
  prefetch: true
  kv_warmup_ratio: 0.2
  prefix_key_hash: fnv1a64
```

Metrics observed: p50 token lat 6ms (ok), p99 token lat 210ms (baseline ~95ms). KV hit rate drops from 78%->46% after warmup window. Eval delta on holdout prompts: top1 accuracy -0.9%, avg token perplexity +3.5%.

Jun: Interesting — warmup_ratio 0.2 seems low. If prefetch warms keys before quantized kernel path populates caches, you could be seeing stale key shape mismatches or KV collisions causing extra work. Did you see any `kvcache-miss` spikes in traces?

Alex C: Yes, trace snippets show a flurry of `kvcache-invalidate` and `kvcache-recompute` events coincident with batching flushes. Also saw a handful of `dequantize-fallback` logs (AWQ->FP32 fallback) which align with the tail latency.

Devon: Could be two interacting effects: 1) AWQ key encoding is slightly different lexicographically vs GPTQ so prefix hashes could cluster; 2) continuous batching with batch_timeout 8ms lets larger batches accumulate which triggers different kernel selection causing occasional slow paths. Worth testing reduced batch_timeout and different hash function.

Sana: Proposed AB matrix: run combinations for kv_warmup_ratio in [0.0, 0.2, 0.5] x batch_timeout_ms in [4,8,12] x prefetch [true,false]. Keep same QPS and run for 30m each. Track: p50/p95/p99 token lat, kv hit rate, dequantize-fallback count, top1 delta on eval set.

Alex C: I kicked off the matrix on canary. Experiment keys: 
- run 1924512401: warmup=0.0, timeout=4, prefetch=false
- run 1924512462: warmup=0.2, timeout=8, prefetch=true
- run 1924512523: warmup=0.5, timeout=12, prefetch=true
Will post summaries as they complete.

eval-bot: Automated eval for run 1924512462 finished: top1 accuracy delta -0.88%, avg perplexity +3.3%, sample regression count 18/2000. Quick note: most regressions are on long-context QA prompts.

Maria P: Thanks. If regressions cluster on long context, maybe kv cache eviction policy interacts with quantized KV sizes — int8 blocks smaller -> eviction at different boundaries. Can you capture per-layer kv size histograms?

Alex C: Good call. Added histograms to the runs. Early look: AWQ int8 KV chunk sizes are ~40% smaller which increases number of chunks per prefix; our eviction logic currently counts chunks, not bytes. That will bias eviction on long prefixes.

Devon: That could explain both lower hit rate and extra recompute thrash. Short-term mitigation: change eviction to be byte-aware or increase `kv_warmup_ratio` so we reduce churn. Long-term: normalize prefix hashing across quantization pipelines.

Sana: Action items:
- Alex: finish matrix and post full table + artifacts (traces, histograms) by EOD.
- Jun: add a quick experiment where we switch hash to `xxh3` for one run.
- Devon: draft a short design note for byte-aware eviction (1-2 paragraphs).

Alex C: Ack — uploading artifacts now. Initial summary for the three runs: 
- warmup=0.0, timeout=4, prefetch=false -> p99 102ms, kv_hit 76%, top1 delta -0.1%
- warmup=0.2, timeout=8, prefetch=true -> p99 210ms, kv_hit 46%, top1 delta -0.88% (the bad one)
- warmup=0.5, timeout=12, prefetch=true -> p99 130ms, kv_hit 62%, top1 delta -0.2%

deploy-bot: Canary rollout for model gpt-7b-awq-int8 in pool canary-1 rolled back at 1924512900 due to p99 alerts.

Maria P: Nice isolation — looks like intermediate warmup+prefetch with aggressive timeout is the sweet spot for this config. Maybe default warmup should be 0.5 when prefetch enabled.

Jun: I ran xxh3 run (1924512666) — similar to warmup=0.2/timeout=8 but kv_hit improved to 55% and p99 dropped to 160ms. So hashing helped but not enough alone.

Devon: I'll draft the byte-aware eviction note and propose a short-term config change: when prefetch=true set kv_warmup_ratio>=0.5 and reduce batch_timeout_ms to <=8 for AWQ.

Alex C: Uploaded full traces + per-layer kv size histograms to the experiment folder. Will re-run the matrix with byte-aware eviction sim turned on in a sandbox. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
